claims.wording: Kudu is the Advent Development maintenance product at usekudu.com, linked to github.com/AdventDevInc/kudu.
The download page offers Kudu 3.10.0, released October 21, 2026, for macOS 12+ with separate Apple silicon and Intel disk images.
The MIT-licensed desktop toolkit is advertised at $0 with no desktop account required; optional Cloud is separate.
Optional Cloud Basic is advertised at $5 USD/device/month and Pro at $9 USD/device/month at base rates, with volume discounts at 50 and 250 devices; no annual commitment is stated.
The documented interactive Cleaner workflow supports category/item review, exclusions and cleanup receipts; receipts are not file backups.
Kudu documents free local folder-size snapshots, automatic snapshots and growth alerts; retention is up to 90 days within 250 MB.
Its free desktop scheduler supports ordered supported tasks, daily/weekly/monthly recurrence and deferral conditions; Kudu must be running.
Kudu documents live CPU, memory, disk and network monitoring with per-process tracking; Mac-specific sensor parity and app/helper aggregation were not verified.

Core cleanup is local, but network access can be used for updates and online features; linked Cloud sends operational data and receives remote commands. New performance recordings and AI analysis require Cloud Pro.
Ordinary browser cache cleaning and opt-in Privacy Traces have different scopes; do not treat all browser data as disposable.
The homepage advertises readable JSON cleanup rules and developer-app/cache coverage, but per-rule macOS coverage has not been audited here.
